mapper.select: SELECT F.F_NAME, F.F_AREA, G.G_CODE, G.G_DUNG, G.G_SEARCH, DATE_FORMAT(G.G_DATE,'%Y년%m월%d일') AS G_DATE, TIME_FORMAT(G.G_TIME,' %H시%i분') AS G_TIME, G.G_PEO, G.G_MAGAM, G.G_INTRO, T.T_NAME, ST.T_NAME AS SEARCH_T_NAME FROM GAMELIST G JOIN FINFO F ON F.F_CODE = G.F_CODE JOIN TEAM T ON G.G_DUNG = T.T_CODE LEFT JOIN TEAM ST ON G.G_SEARCH = ST.T_CODE ORDER BY G.G_DATE, G.G_TIME;

SELECT F.F_NAME, F.F_AREA, G.G_CODE, G.G_DUNG, G.G_SEARCH, DATE_FORMAT(G.G_DATE,'%Y년%m월%d일') AS G_DATE, TIME_FORMAT(G.G_TIME,' %H시%i분') AS G_TIME, G.G_PEO, G.G_MAGAM, G.G_INTRO, T.T_NAME, ST.T_NAME AS SEARCH_T_NAME FROM GAMELIST G JOIN FINFO F ON F.F_CODE = G.F_CODE JOIN TEAM T ON G.G_DUNG = T.T_CODE LEFT JOIN TEAM ST ON G.G_SEARCH = ST.T_CODE WHERE G.G_DUNG IN ( SELECT T_CODE FROM TEAM_MANAGEMENT WHERE U_CODE = #{u_code} AND TM_STATUS = 'APPROVED' ) OR G.G_SEARCH IN ( SELECT T_CODE FROM TEAM_MANAGEMENT WHERE U_CODE = #{u_code} AND TM_STATUS = 'APPROVED' ) ORDER BY G.G_DATE DESC, G.G_TIME DESC;
mapper.update: UPDATE GAMELIST SET G_MAGAM = 3 WHERE G_CODE = #{g_code} AND G_SEARCH IS NOT NULL
